findings: The compact menu stays inside the editor in desktop, mobile, dark, RTL, and 200 percent zoom states.
Keyboard focus remains visible and the menu exposes the complete row, column, alignment, and formatting action chain.
The 20 by 50 split view keeps the wide table scrollable inside the editor without changing the surrounding layout.
Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit completed the same 21-test interaction matrix.
simulationLimitations: Touch input and 200 percent zoom were deterministically simulated in local browsers; no physical touch hardware was used.
Screen-reader semantics were checked through live-region assertions and browser accessibility roles; no external screen-reader application was used.
